settings.gameplay.title: Gameplay
settings.gameplay.auto_adjust.label: Auto Adjust
settings.gameplay.auto_adjust.help: Dynamically adjusts difficulty based on your performance. Speed, distractors, phrase count, and correct-answer probability all scale with your skill.
settings.gameplay.motion_controls.label: Motion Controls
settings.gameplay.motion_controls.help: Use device motion / tilt to control the hoverboard. When disabled, tap to steer.
settings.gameplay.motion_controls.status: Motion not allowed — try again or keep playing with touch
motion.overlay.title: Tilt to Steer
motion.overlay.body: Use motion controls to steer by tilting your device, or keep playing with taps.
motion.overlay.requesting: Allow motion access in the iPhone prompt, then tilt to steer.
motion.overlay.denied_body: No problem. You can try again now, or keep playing with touch controls and re-enable motion later from the menu.
motion.overlay.error_body: Motion access did not turn on. You can try again, or keep playing with touch controls.
settings.gameplay.text_scale.label: Text Scale
settings.gameplay.text_scale.help: Size of phrase text on the road.
settings.advanced.title: Advanced Gameplay
settings.advanced.baseline_speed.label: Baseline Speed
settings.advanced.baseline_speed.help: Starting speed before auto-adjustment. Lower = easier.
settings.advanced.baseline_correct.label: Baseline Correct %
settings.advanced.baseline_correct.help: Starting probability (0–1) that the correct answer is in the choices. Lower = harder.
settings.advanced.baseline_distractors.h: Starting number of wrong answers. Higher = harder.
settings.advanced.baseline_max_phrases.h: Starting max simultaneous phrases. Higher = harder.
settings.advanced.baseline_max_misses.he: Starting tolerance for misses. Higher = more forgiving.
settings.advanced.max_speed.label: Max Speed
settings.advanced.max_speed.help: Maximum speed at the highest difficulty.
settings.advanced.max_distractors.label: Max Distractors
settings.advanced.max_distractors.help: Maximum wrong answers at the highest difficulty.
settings.advanced.max_phrases.label: Max Phrases
settings.advanced.max_phrases.help: Maximum simultaneous phrases at the highest difficulty.
settings.advanced.max_max_misses.label: Max Max Misses
settings.advanced.max_max_misses.help: Maximum miss tolerance at the highest difficulty.
settings.advanced.min_correct.label: Min Correct %
settings.advanced.min_correct.help: Minimum probability of the correct answer at the highest difficulty. 0.1 = 1 in 10.
